def calculateSolarPosition(date, latitude, longitude, pressure, temperature):
    # Convert date to UTC
    utc_date = datetime.datetime(1, 1, 1) + (date - datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(date.timestamp()))
    
    # Calculate solar noon in UTC
    solar_noon_utc = utc_date.hour * 3600 + utc_date.minute / 60
    
    if solar_noon_utc < 0 or solar_noon_utc > 23:
        return "Error"
    
    # Convert to decimal hours and minutes from UTC
    decimal_hours = (solar_noon_utc - 12) % 24
    decimal_minutes = floor((solar_noon_utc - 12) / 60)
    
    # Calculate hour of the day in the Northern Hemisphere
    if latitude > 0:
        direction = "North"
    elif latitude < 0:
        direction = "South"
    else:
        direction = "West" if decimal_hours >= 18 else "East"
        
    # Convert to degrees and minutes
    hours_in_day = 24
    decimal_degrees = (decimal_minutes / hours_in_day) * 3600 + decimal_hours
    
    return f"{hours_in_day}:{decimal_minutes:02d}.{direction}"
    
def calculateSunset(date, latitude):
    # Calculate hour of sunset in the Northern Hemisphere
    decimal_hours = datetime.datetime.strptime(date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "%Y-%m-%d").hour * 3600 + datetime.datetime.strptime(date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"), "%Y-%m-%d").minute / 60
    
    if latitude > 0:
        direction = "North"
    elif latitude < 0:
        direction = "South"
    else:
        direction = "West" if decimal_hours >= 18 else "East"
        
    # Convert to degrees and minutes
    directions = ["N", "S", "E", "W"]
    return f"{decimal_hours:02d}:{directions[directions.index('North')]}"
